newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer despite c.bank support.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer despite c.bank support.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 218-219.50 per dollar, down from 216.50/218 in the morning due to the longer value date of spot deals and despite acitve support from the central bank, dealers said.
"The central bank offered dollars between 217.50-219 levs for most of the day, averting a sharper lev's fall due to the longer value date (of spot deals)," a dealer said.
Foreign currency demand was fairly low today and was mainly aimed at servicing pending payments, traders said. @
The lev traditionally weakens on Thursdays on the local market because that day's spot deals are settled on Monday, allowing dollar buyers to profit on high yield lev deposits during the weekend.
The current large spread between interest rates of dollar- and lev-denominated deposits leaves room for a daily lev's easing by some 1.80 levs per dollar, dealers said.
The central bank's main interest rate is now set at a historic high of 25 percent per month or 300 percent annually. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
